rows.ARS:
Orange-pink Grandiflora.
Registration name: MACwaihe
Exhibition name: Waiheke
rows.Origin:
Bred by Samuel Darragh (1932-2019) McGredy IV (1977).
Introduced in New Zealand by McGredy Roses International (New Zealand) as 'Waiheke'.
rows.Bloom: Orange-pink, ages to lighter . Coral pink with lighter reverse. Mild, rose, spice fragrance. 30 petals. Average diameter 2". In small clusters, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long, pointed buds.
rows.Habit: Bushy, upright. Medium, glossy, dark green foliage.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Heat tolerant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
